<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/location-types"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every LocationType, ordered by name, with its default capacity envelope. PlacementRules reference these by name, so this is the vocabulary a rule author picks from. Keyset-paginated: `limit` and `cursor`; follow `nextCursor` until it is absent.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

A token that does not decode is 400 `invalid-cursor`. Any query parameter the collection does not declare is 400 `unknown-query-parameter`.","schema":{"type":"string"}}]}
